rationale: Lunar orbital terrain patches from the same observation scene share morphological features, lighting geometry, and cratering histories. Random tile splitting causes extreme data leakage and over-optimistic evaluation metrics. Therefore, each split is assigned mutually exclusive geographic formations and distinct LROC NAC scenes.
